children: Japan's Nikkei Stock Average is down 0.1% at 61078.20 as drops in electronics and metals shares offset gains in bank and retail stocks. Advantest is down 4.0% and Sumitomo Electric Industries is 3.2% lower while Mizuho Financial Group is up 5.5% and Nitori Holdings is 3.1% higher. Broader market index Topix is up 0.1% at 3945.74. The dollar is at 159.64 yen, compared with Y160.10 as of Friday's Tokyo stock market close. Investors are focusing on bond yields, crude oil prices and domestic earnings. Dentsu Group is set to announce its quarterly results later Monday. (kosaku.narioka@wsj.com; @kosakunarioka)
